questions.correctFeedback: Finish the first action with 了: 他放了假，就去旅行了。
questions.repairFeedback: Put 了 after the first action: 放了假.

grammarPages.exerciseNote: The book links finished actions with 就 on printed page 387; these model answers follow the printed sentences.

practice.title: Complete the sentences with the 了…就 pattern.

repairs.note: 再 is for a next step still to come; last night already happened, so use 就 … 了.
過 marks something you have done before; here one step simply finished: end with 了.
B is answering, not asking, so no 嗎; last night is past, so end with 了.

items.fallbackRepair: 就 + the next action, and 了 at the end for last night: 就睡覺了.

result.traditional: 我看了書，就睡覺了。
result.simplified: 我看了书，就睡觉了。
result.pinyin: Wǒ kàn le shū, jiù shuìjiào le.
result.english: After reading, I went straight to bed.

segments.traditional: 你們什麼時候去太魯閣？
segments.simplified: 你们什么时候去太鲁阁？

repairs.note: 的 joins a describer to a noun; a finished first step takes 了 right after the verb: 到了.

items.fallbackRepair: Verb + 了 + place for the first step, then the subject + 就: 到了花蓮，我們就去.

result.traditional: 明天到了花蓮，我們就去。
result.simplified: 明天到了花莲，我们就去。
result.pinyin: Míngtiān dào le Huālián, wǒmen jiù qù.
result.english: As soon as we get to Hualien tomorrow, we’ll go.

summary: Use 就 to say the second action follows right after the first one is finished.
Put 了 right after the first action and 就 before the next. You can't leave 就 out.
The next action may also end with 了.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Describe How an Action Turned Out with 得
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe how an action was done or how it turned out.
grammarPages.explanation: Put 得 directly after the verb, then the state complement that describes the action.

teachingGlossary.pinyin: zhè zhāng zhàopiàn lǐ de rén

teachingGlossary.meaning: as well as he introduced it

patternRows.english: Everyone had a wonderful time.

subject.pinyin: zhè zhāng zhàopiàn lǐ de rén

columns.pinyin: zhè zhāng zhàopiàn lǐ de rén

patternRows.english: The people in this photo are smiling very happily.
He introduced his country extremely well.

items.question: When do I use 的 vs 得?
items.answer: Use 的 to describe a noun (漂亮的風景). Use 得 right after an action verb to describe how it is done (玩得很開心).

right.english: I had a great time.

items.question: Where does 得 go if the verb has an object?
items.answer: Either repeat the verb (放假放得不久) or state the activity first as topic (這次放假放得不久).

right.traditional: 這次放假沒有上次放得那麼久。
right.simplified: 这次放假没有上次放得那么久。
right.pinyin: zhè cì fàngjià méiyǒu shàng cì fàng de nàme jiǔ.
right.english: This vacation is not as long as the last one.

text.traditional: 這張照片裡的人都笑得很開心。
text.simplified: 这张照片里的人都笑得很开心。
text.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn lǐ de rén dōu xiào de hěn kāixīn.
text.english: The people in this photo are all smiling very happily.

words.pinyin: zhè zhāng zhàopiàn lǐ de rén

text.traditional: A：他介紹自己的國家介紹得非常好。 B：是啊，我們都沒有他介紹得那麼好。
text.simplified: A：他介绍自己的国家介绍得非常好。 B：是啊，我们都没有他介绍得那么好。
text.pinyin: A: Tā jièshào zìjǐ de guójiā jièshào de fēicháng hǎo. B: Shì a, wǒmen dōu méiyǒu tā jièshào de nàme hǎo.
text.english: A: He introduced his country extremely well. B: Indeed, none of us introduced it as well as he did.

words.meaning: as well as he introduced it

text.traditional: 到了山上，我們玩得非常高興。
text.simplified: 到了山上，我们玩得非常高兴。
text.pinyin: Dào le shānshang, wǒmen wán de fēicháng gāoxìng.
text.english: When we reached the mountain, we had a tremendously good time.

segments.traditional: 你們昨天去日月潭了嗎？
segments.simplified: 你们昨天去日月潭了吗？

repairs.note: A how-it-went comment after a verb is joined by 得, not 的.
It rained, so it wasn’t much fun: 不太開心, not 很開心.

items.fallbackRepair: Verb + 得 + the comment: 玩得不太開心. 不 goes after 得, not before the verb.

result.traditional: 去了，可是我們玩得不太開心，因為下雨了。
result.simplified: 去了，可是我们玩得不太开心，因为下雨了。
result.pinyin: Qù le, kěshì wǒmen wán de bú tài kāixīn, yīnwèi xià yǔ le.
result.english: Yes, but we didn’t have much fun, because it rained.

repairs.note: A asked about speaking, so the verb is 說 both times.
了 can’t join a verb to a how-well comment; use 得: 說得很好.
A how-well comment after a verb is joined by 得, not 的.

items.fallbackRepair: With an object, say the verb again before 得: 說中文說得很好.

result.traditional: 會，他說中文說得很好。
result.simplified: 会，他说中文说得很好。
result.pinyin: Huì, tā shuō Zhōngwén shuō de hěn hǎo.
result.english: Yes, he speaks Chinese very well.

summary: Put 得 right after the verb, then say how the action was done or turned out: 玩得很開心.
Use 得 after an action verb, and use 的 to describe a noun.
If the verb has an object, repeat the verb: 放假放得不久. Or put the activity first as the topic.

dialogue.title: 在台灣旅行 · Traveling in Taiwan
dialogue.setting: 對話二 · Dialogue 2

text.traditional: 放假的時候，你去太魯閣了嗎？
text.simplified: 放假的时候，你去太鲁阁了吗？
text.pinyin: Fàngjià de shíhòu, nǐ qù Tàilǔgé le ma?
text.english: Did you go to Taroko during the vacation?

text.traditional: 我本來要去那裡，可是因為沒有車票了，所以後來決定去高雄玩。
text.simplified: 我本来要去那里，可是因为没有车票了，所以后来决定去高雄玩。
text.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái yào qù nàlǐ, kěshì yīnwèi méiyǒu chēpiào le, suǒyǐ hòulái juédìng qù Gāoxióng wán.
text.english: I originally intended to go there, but because there were no more train tickets, I later decided to go to Kaohsiung.

text.traditional: 高雄好玩嗎？
text.simplified: 高雄好玩吗？
text.pinyin: Gāoxióng hǎowán ma?
text.english: Was Kaohsiung fun?

text.traditional: 很好玩，我坐了三個半小時的火車，下了火車就坐捷運去西子灣了，那裡風景很漂亮。
text.simplified: 很好玩，我坐了三个半小时的火车，下了火车就坐捷运去西子湾了，那里风景很漂亮。
text.pinyin: Hěn hǎowán, wǒ zuò le sān ge bàn xiǎoshí de huǒchē, xià le huǒchē jiù zuò jiéyùn qù Xīzǐwān le, nàlǐ fēngjǐng hěn piàoliàng.
text.english: Very fun! I took the train for three and a half hours, and as soon as I got off the train, I took the MRT to Sizihwan. The scenery there was gorgeous.

text.traditional: 你應該搭高鐵去，這樣更快，只需要一個半小時。
text.simplified: 你应该搭高铁去，这样更快，只需要一个半小时。
text.pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi dā gāotiě qù, zhèyàng gèng kuài, zhǐ xūyào yí ge bàn xiǎoshí.
text.english: You should have taken the High Speed Rail (HSR); it’s much faster, taking only an hour and a half.

text.traditional: 好，我下次一定要坐高鐵。你呢？這次旅行怎麼樣？
text.simplified: 好，我下次一定要坐高铁。你呢？这次旅行怎么样？
text.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ xià cì yídìng yào zuò gāotiě. Nǐ ne? Zhè cì lǚxíng zěnmeyàng?
text.english: All right, I'll definitely take the HSR next time. How about you? How was your trip?

text.traditional: 我玩得很開心，可是旅館的房間有點問題，浴室沒有水。
text.simplified: 我玩得很开心，可是旅馆的房间有点问题，浴室没有水。
text.pinyin: Wǒ wán de hěn kāixīn, kěshì lǚguǎn de fángjiān yǒudiǎn wèntí, yùshì méiyǒu shuǐ.
text.english: I had a great time, but there was a problem with the hotel room: the bathroom had no water.

text.traditional: 沒有水？那你怎麼洗澡？
text.simplified: 没有水？那你怎么洗澡？
text.pinyin: Méiyǒu shuǐ? Nà nǐ zěnme xǐzǎo?
text.english: No water? Then how did you take a shower?

text.traditional: 後來我換了房間，旅館老闆說付一半的錢就好了。
text.simplified: 后来我换了房间，旅馆老板说付一半的钱就好了。
text.pinyin: Hòulái wǒ huàn le fángjiān, lǚguǎn lǎobǎn shuō fù yíbàn de qián jiù hǎo le.
text.english: Later I changed rooms, and the hotel owner said paying half price was fine.

text.traditional: 合歡山下雪了嗎？冷不冷？
text.simplified: 合欢山下雪了吗？冷不冷？
text.pinyin: Héhuān Shān xiàxuě le ma? Lěng bù lěng?
text.english: Did it snow on Hehuanshan? Was it cold?

text.traditional: 下雪了，很冷，風也很大，可是很好玩。你看，這是我照的相片。
text.simplified: 下雪了，很冷，风也很大，可是很好玩。你看，这是我照的相片。
text.pinyin: Xiàxuě le, hěn lěng, fēng yě hěn dà, kěshì hěn hǎowán. Nǐ kàn, zhè shì wǒ zhào de xiàngpiàn.
text.english: It did snow. It was very cold, and the wind was strong, but it was really fun. Look, these are photos I took.

text.traditional: 你笑得好開心，風景真漂亮！
text.simplified: 你笑得好开心，风景真漂亮！
text.pinyin: Nǐ xiào de hǎo kāixīn, fēngjǐng zhēn piàoliàng!
text.english: You're smiling so happily, and the scenery is really beautiful!
